data.summary: The pod startup took 33.0 s, significantly exceeding the 10.0 s SLO. The primary cause was the application's initialisation phase, specifically the downloading and loading of a model. The model download alone contributed 25.648 s to the overall delay.

findings.statement: The pod startup took 33.0 s, which is above the SLO threshold of 10.0 s.
Within 'app_init', the 'model.download' span took 25.648 s to download 262144000 bytes from 'http://model-hub.kubesage-infra.svc.cluster.local/weights.bin'.
The 'model.load' span took an additional 0.156 s.
The combined model download and load time was 25.804 s, which is 78.2% of the total startup time.

ruled_out.reason: The image pull duration was 4.921 s for 53328919 bytes, which is not the dominant factor in the 33.0 s startup time.
The image pull throughput was 10837009 bytes/s, and the image pull duration was not the main contributor to the slow startup.
The scheduling phase duration was 0.0 s and there were no failed scheduling events.
The readiness phase duration was 0.0 s and there were no probe failures after the application was ready.

recommendations.rationale: The model download is the longest phase. Consider pre-baking the model into the container image, using a local cache on the node, or optimising the model hub's serving performance.
A smaller model would reduce download time. Investigate model compression or quantization techniques.
